facts.label: Agora e planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para agora e am/is/are going to + verbo para planos: She is sleeping. I’m going to buy soup.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar de agora, use am/is/are + -ing: She is sleeping. I’m waiting. Pergunte What are you doing? e responda com a mesma forma. Não esqueça o verbo to be.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo: I’m going to buy soup. We are going to be next. Depois de going to, use o verbo base, sem -ing.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “estou esperando” e “vou comprar”.

pages.title: A pharmacy · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday evening in a pharmacy in Chicago. The lights are bright and white. A long line stands near the counter. Theo checks a small paper. His friend Alma stands behind him. They start to talk.
“Hi, Theo! Are you waiting for medicine?” says Alma. “Yes, I am. My sister is sick, so I’m picking it up for her.” says Theo. “Oh, I’m sorry. What is she doing now?” says Alma.
